content: Yesuusa pettii sila atha patheeza
Yeypp guye, Yesuusa Ayihuditay bonchchiza baalayis Yerusalaame yhanigeeza.
Yerusalaame Duritay Penge kale Ibraysxe doonar Beetesayida giz deelee yeza. Ye haathay lanqqe ichchin shemppo bessitay yeza.
[Yeyid haathay eni7odana naagiza gaame harigntteezittay, to7itay, wobbitayinnee gundditay woyi7iza.
Abis giiko, pettii pettii toke Goda kiitanchchay teqintteez haatha wodhdhii eni7isiza. Haathay eni7odar tiin geleez athay fana aykkeez aba harggepekka paxiza.]
Ye aqayid hasttamannee hosppun laythi harggintteez pettii athay yeza.
Yesuusa ye atha bi7ii, ma gaame wode harggintteezana erii athayiko, «Paxodayis koyinee?» yeegeeza.
Harggintteez athay maaqqii, «Godayoo, haathay eni7odar tana haathay gancce oliza asii baaya. Taanii gelod hanodar haray taapp tiinattii geliza» yeegeeza.
Yesuusa eziko, «Denddii eqqoba; ne arssa tookkii qitoba» yeegeeza.
Athay izir ellis paxeeza; fa arssa tookkii qiteeza. Yeyi maala gallasar haneeza.
Yeyi gishos, Ayihuditay paxeez athayko, «Yhayino sa7ay maala; neenii ne arssa tookkizay woga baaya» yeegeeza.
Zin athay, «Tana patheezay, ne arssa tookkii qitoba geeza» yeegii maheeza.
Unttii eziko, «Nena, ne arssa tookkii qitoba geezay E oonoo?» yeegii oyiceeza.
Zin Yesuusa ye aqayid gaame as ganccer erisekkazar aadhii qiteez gishos athay fana patheezay oonazako erooya.
Yesuusa guyepp ye atha Xooss Keetha denggii, «Yhatt, neenii paxeeza; yhaypp iita baz nena hellaamay garkk maaqqii nagara oothippe» yeegeeza.
Yeypp guye, athay yhanigii fana patheezay Yesuusa maaqqeezana Ayihuditayis odeeza.
Yesuusa yeya maala gallas ootheez gishos Ayihuditay Yesuusa bay7ith aykkeeza.
Yesuusa maaqqii, «Ta Aday ubba wode oothiza; taakka oothodayis beeziza» yeegeeza.
Yesuusa maala bonchcheka gishos aadda baazin Xoossa fa Ade gi fana Xoossar ukkulsseez gishos Ayihuditay eza wodhodayis tiinaasaypp miinthii koyiza.
Xooss Na7ay mawute
Yesuusa mahii, «Taanii yinttis turo odiza; Na7ay fa aaddas abikka oothodayis danda7ooya. E fa Aday oothodar be7eezana aadda oothiza. Aday oothizana Na7aykka oothiza.
Aday fa Na7a qadhdhiza gishos E oothiz ootho ubba fa Na7a beeziza. Yi malabaz goday garkk E yhaypp aadhiz ooso fa Na7a beezoda.
Aday yhayqqeezita yhayiqopp denthii unttis de7o inggizay garkk Na7aykka fa koyizitayis de7o inggiza.
Aday Na7ayis pirdde mawute ubba inggeezapp attin E oonakka pirddooya.
Asay ubbitay Ada bonchchizay garkk Na7akka bonchchoda. Na7a bonchchowa oonkka Na7a kiitteez Adakka bonchchooya.
«Taanii yinttis turo odiza; ta qaala si7izitayinnee tana azazeezana ammanizay medhina de7o yeza. E yhayiqopp de7o piinggeez gishos pirddinttamii.
Taanii yinttis turo odiza; yhayqqeez asay Xooss Na7a qaala si7iz wode ye7oda; yeykka yhatte. Ye qaala si7izay de7or yezoda.
Adayis ees de7o yezay garkk Na7ayiskka ees de7o yezoday garkk inggintteeza.
As Na7a maaqqiz gishos Aday Na7ayis pirdde mawute inggeeza.
«Duufo yezitay e qaala si7ii dendod wode ye7od gishos yhaya malabaz giippate.
Lo77o ootheezittay de7or yezodayis ma iita ootheezittay pirdde ekkodayis duufopp dendoda.
«Taanii ta mawuter ababazikka oothodayis danda7ooya. Xoossay taasi odeezay garkk pirddiza. Taanii tana kiitteezay koyiz baz oothizapp attin ta koyiz baz oothowa gishos ta pirdday tuma.
Yesuusas markkatteez asito
«Taanii tabaz markkatiko ta markkatithay tuma baaya.
Ta bagga markkattizay hara yeza; E tabaz markkattizay tuma maaqqizana taanii eriza.
«Yi Waannisako as kiittin E tumas markkatteeza.
Taanii yeya yinttis odizay, yi attod garkk geezapp attin as markkatithii taas koshsheez gishsho baaya.
Waannisa muqaadday garkk eexittar poo7eeza. Yi xiqqa wodes E poo7ayid ufaytteeza.
«Zin taasi Waannisapp aadhiz markka yeza. Taanii oothod garkk ta Aday taasi inggeez oositay ta bagga markkattiza; Aday tana azazeezana beeziza.
«Ma tana kiitteez Aday fa ubbas tabaz markkattiza. Yi E qaala ubbarakka si7ibe7ekka woy e malla bi7ibee7ekkaya.
E azazeezana yi ammanoowa gishos e qaalay yi wozina gancce baaya.
«Geeshsha Maxaapitaypp medhina de7o demmadbaz yinttis aazin unttan pilagiza; unttii tabaz markkattiza.
Zin yi de7o denggodays taako ye7odayis koyooya.
«Asapp taanii bonchcho koyooya.
Zin taanii yi wozina gancce Xooss qadhe baza eriza.
Taanii ta Aday mawuter ye7eeza, zin tana mokkekkaya. Haray fa mawuter yi7iz wode eza mokkiza.
Yi pettay pettaypp bonchcho koyizitay, pettii Xoossapp yi7iz galata ekkodayis koyoozitay, wayizii tana ammanodayis danda7ee?
«Taanii ta Aday tiina yinttan mootizabaz yinttis aazippe. Yinttan mootoday yi ufayssar naagiz Muse.
Yi Muse ammaneez baz maaqqeezako E ta bagga xaafeez gishos tanakka ammanodazin.
Zin yi E xaafeezana ammanaam ixxiko ta qaala wayizii ammanodee?» yeegeeza.
